definitions.gloss: Japanese national; Japanese citizen (esp. one abroad)
definitions.explanation: A Japanese person, used in news and official language, mostly about Japanese citizens who are overseas.

examples.japanese: {邦人|ほうじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦{在留|ざいりゅう}→在留：12128_zairyuu⟧{邦人|ほうじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{呼|よ}びかけられた→呼びかける：06480_yobikakeru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese residents were urged to be cautious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外務省|がいむしょう}→外務省：31654_gaimushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{邦人|ほうじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安否|あんぴ}→安否：16157_anpi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}している→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦{最中|さいちゅう}→最中：02821_saichuu⟧だ。
examples.english: The Foreign Ministry is in the middle of confirming the safety of Japanese nationals in the area.

notes:
Seen almost entirely in news reports and government notices, especially after disasters and incidents abroad. {邦|ほう} means "our country" (Japan), as in ⟦{邦画|ほうが}→邦画：14740_houga⟧ "Japanese film" and ⟦{邦楽|ほうがく}→邦楽：14456_hougaku⟧ "Japanese music."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{在留|ざいりゅう}→在留：12128_zairyuu⟧{邦人|ほうじん}・{在外|ざいがい}{邦人|ほうじん}: Japanese living abroad
- {邦人|ほうじん}⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧: protection of Japanese nationals
- {邦人|ほうじん}⟦{旅行者|りょこうしゃ}→旅行者：22927_ryokousha⟧: Japanese travelers
- {邦人|ほうじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安否|あんぴ}→安否：16157_anpi⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧: checking on the safety of Japanese nationals

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧: Japanese person; the everyday word
- ⟦{法人|ほうじん}→法人：13298_houjin⟧: a legal entity, a corporation (same reading)
